tour.title: Return App Architecture & Core Entry Point
tour.description: The system provides an enterprise returns reconciliation engine for VB Exports. The server entry in server/index.ts bootstraps Express 4, manages TLS connection pooling to PostgreSQL, mounts subrouters, and streams real-time updates.

tour.title: Multi-Tenant Security & Scope Invariant
tour.description: Every query touching account data strictly enforces the signed-in user's account scope via server/access.ts. Admin-only endpoints require the Admin role, and passwords are encrypted with bcrypt.

tour.title: Inward Return Scanning & Verification Engine
tour.description: When packages arrive physically at the warehouse, barcodes are scanned either via the React console (src/pages/ScanReturns.tsx) or the native Android client (ScannerActivity.kt). Lookup occurs via server/register-service.ts with atomic deduplication locks.

tour.title: Marketplace Return Uploads & Staged Activation
tour.description: Marketplace reports (Meesho, Flipkart, Myntra, Amazon, Ajio) are parsed and staged for 15 minutes in memory. Only validated, scannable rows activate into lookup groups under an advisory lock without overwriting historical scan snapshots.

tour.title: Claims Management & Evidence Media Vault
tour.description: Disputed returns (damaged, missing, wrong items) trigger claims. Photo and 480p unboxing video evidence is uploaded, streamed via HTML5 video lightbox, and tracked with real-time INR totals in src/pages/Claims.tsx.

tour.title: Desktop Automation Engine & Supplier Panel Bots
tour.description: The desktop automation engine (desktop-agent/src/desktop-app-server.ts) leases claim jobs and runs headless Chromium bots (such as Meesho) to automatically upload evidence and file dispute tickets without operator manual entry.

tour.title: Iron Send & Operations Tracking
tour.description: Operational garment handling is tracked in src/pages/IronTracking.tsx and server/iron.ts. Returns sent for pressing are batched and checked in by the Inward Team with live WebSocket updates.

tour.title: OMSGuru Master Catalog & Channel Bridge
tour.description: The bridge in server/oms/master-bridge.ts reconciles active channel listings against the 120k+ product master table, backfilling catalog images and resolving unmapped marketplace SKUs.
